question.title: Design a DSU
question.content:
Design a Disjoint Set Union (DSU) data structure.

Implement the DSU class:

  • DSU(int n) Initializes the object with n elements.
  • int find(int x) Returns the representative of the set containing x.
  • void union(int x, int y) Unions the sets containing x and y.

 

Constraints:

  • 1 <= n <= 105
  • At most 105 calls will be made.
